docs.summary: A global rule that writes some objects as a key instead of their content, for objects that live in a store of their own (an asset database). The value passed to the outermost Serialize call is always written in full, so an object can still be saved as itself. Set one on [`ReferenceRule`](#api~Prowl.Echo.Serializer~ReferenceRule).
The reserved compound key stubs are written under, for example "$asset".
